name: deepweather
description: Explainable passage-weather risk audit for sailors — local prototype

scripts.test: npm run check:contracts && npm run build -w engine && npm run typecheck -w engine && npm run test -w engine && npm run typecheck -w viewer && npm run test -w viewer --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w engine && npm run build -w viewer
scripts.build:pages: npm run build && node scripts/build-pages.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.check:contracts: python3 scripts/check_shared_contracts.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_shared_contracts.py
